description: Search published funding opportunities in the Ethereum ecosystem — grants, hackathons, bounties, accelerators, VC funds and RFPs — by keyword, funding type, status, ecosystem, award size and deadline window. Returns a short row per match: title, organizations, award range, next deadline and the id to pass to fetch_opportunity for the full record. Full descriptions are not included in these results.

inputSchema.description: Filters for the opportunity list. Every field is optional.

deadlineAfter.description: RFC 3339 instant. Only entries whose earliest upcoming fixed deadline is at or after it. Entries with no upcoming fixed deadline (rolling programs, all-past deadlines, or none at all) are EXCLUDED by this filter.

deadlineBefore.description: RFC 3339 instant. Only entries whose earliest upcoming fixed deadline is at or before it. Entries with no upcoming fixed deadline are EXCLUDED by this filter.

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem names, e.g. Optimism, Base. Values OR together.

fundingType.description: Restrict to these funding types. One of: grant, hackathon, bounty, accelerator, vc_fund, rfp.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

maxAward.description: Maximum award or budget, in major currency units.

minAward.description: Minimum award or budget, in major currency units.

organization.description: Organization slug. Matches an operating OR a sponsoring organization.

q.description: Free-text search over title, summary and description.

sort.description: Sort key; defaults to nextDeadlineAt, the earliest fixed deadline still in the future. Entries without one sort last.

status.description: Restrict to these statuses. One of: upcoming, open, closed, archived.

name: search_opportunities

applyUrl.description: The hub's counted redirect to the application page.

awardSummary.description: Rendered here from the numeric funding fields; never publisher prose.

ecosystems.description: Third-party text, at most 8 values of 40 characters.

ecosystemsOmitted.description: How many ecosystem values were dropped by the cap. 0 when the list is complete.

id.description: Public id, `<namespace>:<local>`. Pass this to fetch_opportunity.

namespace.description: The publishing organization's namespace — the id's prefix.

nextDeadline.description: Earliest fixed deadline still in the future, or null when there is none.

organizations.description: The organizations that operate the program.

name.description: Third-party text: the organization's published display name.

sourceUrl.description: The hub's counted redirect to the original listing.

total.description: Total matches. An empty result is `total === 0`; `totalPages` is 1.

totalPages.description: Always at least 1, even for an empty result.

title: Search funding opportunities
